title: Trump’s Economic Threat Puts Focus on Iran’s Trading Partners
summary_full: President Trump appeared to suggest that the United States would impose economic penalties on countries that do business with Iran, though he did not specify what actions he would take.
summary_public: President Trump appeared to suggest that the United States would impose economic penalties on countries that do business with Iran, though he did not specify what actions he would take.
